correctness.rationale: Massri 2026 Theorem 1.1 provides exact three-quadric regular sequence. The SL2 symplectic moment-map derivative gives singular support C_r with no other singular points. The explicit order-(r-1) transvectant formulas yield two independent pivot directions and a nondegenerate antidiagonal Hessian. The equivariant Morse critical value has exact possible degree m+1 and must be nonzero because the singular support is one-dimensional. Local Jacobian quotient is C{s,t}/(t^m). Reproducible exact rational calculations in r=5,7,9,11,13 supplement this argument; these checks are not used to infer the general theorem.

originality.rationale: New content is exact global singular support, transverse A_m normal form and length m. The 2013 paper already notes the singular curve and degree eight, while the 2026 paper proves general complete-intersection and tangent-cone theorems; neither supplies the stated higher-order local analytic conclusions. Targeted statement-level searches found no stronger covering claim. Residual risk is acknowledged; lack of a match alone is not novelty evidence.
